lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mg12Fe4Co2 (reduced formula Mg6Fe2Co) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 18 atoms in the unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows all Co, Fe, and Mg centers adopt a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 geometric neighbors each; Co and Fe are coordinated by 12 Mg neighbors, while Mg centers have 4 Co/Fe and 8 Mg neighbors, with neighbor distances ranging from about 2.85 to 3.15 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component containing all 18 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis indicates that 12-vertex Mg polyhedra exhibit corner-, edge-, and face-sharing contacts.
